Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this enthralling encounter but the action in the 2022 Women's World Cup continues on Tuesday, the 15th of March. Australia Women will take on West Indies Women in what seems to be a tasty battle. That match will start at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, the previous day) but the build up will begin a lot sooner. Do join us for that one. Cheers!

South Africa Women captain, Sune Luus says that they have a world-class bowling line up and they wanted to put the opposition under pressure. She says that Kapp has been class and she is an inspiration for young boys and girls. States that this was a  team effort and she is proud of it. She says that they have made history today and says that everyone back in South Africa would be very happy and proud. Tells that it is exciting to win games even though they have not played their best cricket.

Heather Knight the England Women skipper, says that it is a difficult pill to swallow losing three games in a row and they just shot themselves on the foot while fielding early on. Adds that they would have liked to get 15-20 runs more. Tells that they need to win their remaining games and win them well to have a shot and just have to beat India in the next game.

Marizanne Kapp is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her five-wicket haul and also for her antics with the bat at the death. Kapp says that she wants to thank God firstly. Tells that this was a big game for them and they are happy to win this game. She mentions that they all remember the last semi-final and came out with better plans today. She says that they have still not played their best cricket but have stitched together wins and that is a good thing for them.
Time for the presentation...

England Women will feel hard done yet again but once again it could have been really different had they held onto their chances early in the innings but instead for only the second time in the history of this competition they have failed to defend a score of above 200. This has now become a pattern for the defending champions who are now seriously in danger of getting knocked out of the competition. Anya Shrubsole gave them the perfect start by knocking over the dangerous Lizelle Lee but they couldn't press the issue for the next 10 overs or so. The wicket did come but once again the English bowlers allowed Wolvaardt and Luus to build up a partnership. The wickets did come though in the latter half of the innings and Sophie Ecclestone bowled her heart out. But the experience of Katherine Brunt and Natalie Sciver wasn't seen as both of them gave away boundaries at important stages of the chase. England now have to win all their remaining matches and pray for a miracle to make it through to the semifinals.

South Africa Women are the team on the rise and it is now the third time in a row that they have managed to get over the line in a pressure situation. This tells you how good they are holding on to their nerves when it gets edgy out there. After losing power-hitter Lizelle Lee early in the innings, the repair work was done by Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits. Brits fell but Wolvaardt carried on and was well supported by the skipper Sune Luus. The pair put their team in a commanding position with Wolvaardt getting to yet another half century. Both of them fell though in quick succession and it was then time for Marizanne Kapp to step up with the bat. Kapp hit a few lusty blows but got out before crossing the finish line. The experience of Trisha Chetty and Shabnim Ismail though saw South Africa home and along with the Aussies, they are looking like the team to beat.

My word! How many more humdingers are we going to see in this tournament? South Africa Women have managed to make it three wins in a row and it has been a gutsy victory over the defending champions. It's their highest ever successful run-chase in a World Cup match and they have beaten England for the first time in a World Cup game in over 20 years. England Women succumb to a third straight defeat and all of them have gone down the wire. The defending champions seem to be on the brink of getting knocked out of the competition already.

South Africa Women win! What a victory this is! Natalie Sciver bangs this one short on middle. Trisha Chetty pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder in the ring and takes a single needed to win this game. They are all pumped up and rightly so, this was a very important game for both the teams and England have now lost three games in the row. South Africa Women win by 3 wickets with four balls to spare.

WIDE! A length delivery down the leg side. Trisha Chetty looks to clip it but misses. Umpire signals this as a wide and just a run needed now! England look down and out now, unless there is some miracle!

NOT OUT! Tight, very tight but two crucial runs for South Africa Women! A length delivery around leg. Trisha Chetty clips it fine towards long leg and tries to come back for the second. The throw is good from the deep and Trisha Chetty dives to make her ground as the keeper whips the bails off. The leg umpire takes it upstairs and it shows that Trisha Chetty is inside her crease. So just 2 needed now!

Is that a Run-Out? The appeal is taken upstairs but looking at Heather Knight's face it looks like Trisha Chetty has made it back in time. The replays roll in and we can see that the bat was slid in before the bails were whipped off.
The experienced Natalie Sciver has been handed the ball. She has struggled with her line a bit today but can she defend 3 runs and pull off a memorable victory?
A dot ball now! 4 runs needed off the final over! A length delivery on middle and leg. Shabnim Ismail makes a little bit room but mistimes her swing to mid-wicket.
Just a boundary away now! A length delivery, outside off. Trisha Chetty hits this to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Shabnim Ismail works it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! This will ease the nerves for South Africa Women! A length delivery, outside off. Shabnim Ismail throws her bat at it and gets this through backward point for a boundary.
Shabnim Ismail who walked off the pitch in the first innings with a toe injury comes out to bat. Could she be the hero for her side?

OUT! LBW! Another twist in the tale! A big, big wicket this! Kapp departs and this can change the game in England's favour! A length delivery on middle. Kapp looks to sweep it away but misses. The ball hits her pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger. Kapp takes the review but it looks dead straight. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows three reds. So Kapp has to walk back and Anya Shrubsole strikes.

Marizanne Kapp takes the review for an LBW decision. Well, it looked dead straight at first glance and if Kapp has got no inside edge on it, she could be on her way. What a moment in the match this could prove to be! UltraEdge confirms that there's no bat involved and Ball Tracker comes up with three reds. Anya Shrubsole is absolutely ecstatic.
A shorter delivery on middle. Trisha Chetty pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Who will bowl the all-important penultimate over? It's going to be Anya Shrubsole.
A dot ball to end the over! A flatter ball, on off. Kapp blocks it out. 11 needed now from 12 balls!

FOUR! Now this could well be the defining moment of the game! This is a crucial over and Kapp gets a boundary, off the edge but still a boundary. This is tossed up on off. Kapp goes for a big heave across the line but gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes towards the third man fence for a boundary.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Kapp blocks it out.
Slower and slightly shorter on off. Kapp defends it towards the off side. A dot ball again!
Slower in the air and turning away from middle. Kapp defends it out.
A flatter delivery on off. Trisha Chetty pushes it to covers for a single. So a single off the first ball.
Sophie Ecclestone who was being held back for her final over is finally brought back into the attack. Massive six deliveries coming up. Can Ecclestone conjure up a bit of magic here?
A fullish delivery on off. Trisha Chetty swings across the line and gets the inside half of her blade. The ball goes towards deep square leg for a single. 16 needed now from 18 balls.
A fuller delivery on middle. Kapp drills it straight down the ground for a single.

In the air but safe! A shorter delivery on off. Trisha Chetty pulls it but fails to get any timing. The ball goes in the air and falls in the vacant region in front of deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
A length delivery, outside off. Kapp pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Ohh...an outside edge this time! A full delivery on middle. Kapp looks to push it away but gets a thick outside edge off the bounce to short third man.
A length delivery, outside off. Trisha Chetty cuts it to third man for a single.
A length delivery, on off. Kapp pushes it to covers. Dot ball and 21 needed now from 24 balls!
Back of a length, around off. Trisha Chetty steers it to third man for a single. Brunt has fallen on the turf after delivering the ball and England also seem to be in trouble now.
Back of a length, on the body. Smart from Marizanne Kapp as she just dabs it down towards square leg and picks up a single right after the big hit.
SIX! Ohh...this might well be the defining blow! A low full toss on the pads. Kapp flicks this over the backward square leg fence for a maximum. Big moment in the game this.
A dot ball now! A lovely slower delivery. It is back of a hand delivery and outside off. Kapp looks to cut it but misses.
Shorter length on middle. Kapp pulls it towards backward square leg for a couple. Nice shot and two important runs for South Africa Women!
A full delivery on middle. Trisha Chetty flicks it towards the deep square leg region for a couple. 31 needed now from 30 balls! It is getting tense out there.
A length delivery on middle. Kapp drives it to long on for a single.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Chetty gets across and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Chetty works it towards mid on.
A length delivery, on off. Trisha Chetty blocks it out.
A length delivery on middle. Kapp turns it towards the backward square leg region for a single.
Anya Shrubsole is back into the attack. She has bowled 6 overs so far and has given away just 17 runs, picking up a wicket as well.
A fuller delivery on middle. Kapp drives it to long on for a single. 200 up for South Africa Women and 36 needed now from 36 balls.
A fuller delivery on off. Kapp drives it to mid off now.
Trisha Chetty is the new batter in for South Africa Women.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ohh..this is unlucky for Chloe Tryon and South Africa Women! However, it is just what England need. A full delivery on middle. Kapp drives it straight down the ground. Brunt takes her right hand out to stop it but gets a finger tip to it. The ball deflects onto the stumps and shatters it. Chloe Tryon who is backing up too much is short of her crease as she puts in a dive. Big wicket this!

Is that a Run-Out? Has it happened again in the tournament? Surely not, right? The ball goes off Brunt's right hand and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. It is taken upstairs and the replays show that Chloe Tryon is backing up way too much and is well out of her crease. This is the third or fourth time in this tournament that this has happened.

FOUR! A very important boundary this! A fuller delivery on middle. Kapp works it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. In the gap and the fielder makes a valiant effort but it goes away towards the fence.

A huge shout but it is going down leg. A full delivery around leg. Chloe Tryon skips down the track and looks to clip it but misses. the ball hits her back leg and there is an appeal but umpire turns it down. A leg bye taken.
Brunt goes slightly shorter around off. Chloe Tryon punches it through cover-point for a couple.
Dot ball to end the over! An excellent over, just one run from it! Tossed up nicely on middle. Kapp defends it off the front foot towards the leg side. 44 needed now from 42 balls!
Slower in the air, on off. Kapp defends this off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off. Kapp drives it to the cover fielder.
A flatter and quicker one on off. Kapp blocks it out.
Slower in the air again, on off. Chloe Tryon takes a step or two forward and pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up nicely on off. Chloe Tryon looks to hit it away but gets the inside edge towards the leg side.
A quick single to end the over! A length ball, on off. Chloe Tryon pushes it with soft hands towards point and takes a single. 45 needed now from 48 balls!
Drifting on the pads now. Kapp works it towards fine leg for a single.
A single now! A length delivery, on off. Chloe Tryon pushes this in the gap towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, on off. Chloe Tryon pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Ohh..edge but runs away for a boundary! A good-length delivery around off. Chloe Tryon punches this but gets the outside edge. The ball goes through right of the keeper for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Tryon looks to push it towards the off side but gets beaten.

NOT OUT! At first glance, it seemed to be sliding down leg and that's what it was and Marizanne Kapp survives. This is another arm-ball from Sophie Ecclestone and Kapp is once again pushed onto the back foot. The ball slides into leg stump and Kapp gets caught on the crease as the ball raps her on the pads. Ecclestone with a huge appeal and it is given OUT. Kapp reviews it right away and there's no spike on UltraEdge. Ball Tracker though shows that the ball was missing leg stump by a few inches. 52 needed now off 54 balls.

Review! Marizanne Kapp has been given LBW here. She takes a review! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the ball is missing stumps. So the decision will be overturned and Kapp survives.
Sliding on with the arm again. Kapp goes on the back foot and keeps it out.
Flatter delivery, on off. This is pushed away towards point.

FOUR BYES! Unlucky for the bowler but it is what it is.Nicely flighted, around middle. Marizanne Kapp gets the front leg out of the way and goes for the big hoick leg side. She misses and the bounce eludes the keeper as well. The ball runs away into the fence.
Here comes the arm-ball! On off and slides in sharply. Kapp does well to keep it out.
Floated up, full and outside off. Tryon pushes it down to sweeper cover for one.
Angled into middle and leg, pushed straight towards mid on. 57 required now off 60 balls.
Fullish ball, around off and worked through covers for a single.
FOUR! THis is proving to be a good over for South Africa Women. Short and wide, Tryon hangs back and hammers it to the right of third man and picks up a boundary.
There is width on offer and Kapp slashes it away. The ball goes straight to deep point though and it will only be a single.
A length ball, around off. This is tapped towards cover-point.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Pitched up, around middle. Marizanne Kapp whacks it over mid on and picks up an important boundary for her side.
On off, kept out on the off side.
Chloe Tryon is in at number 7.

OUT! TAKEN! Sophie Ecclestone comes back into the attack and provides another breakthrough for England Women. This is tossed up well outside off and turns away further. It is there to hit but Mignon du Preez is already under pressure due to the dot balls. Du Preez drives away from the body, with hard hands and gets an outside edge on it. Amy Jones fumbles it at first but manages to grab it. That is a sharp catch and England Women in the driving seat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly flighted, on off. Mignon du Preez leans forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker one, darted into off. Du Preez keeps it out but the dot balls are building up pressure here.
Good stop! Short and wide, cutaway hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Sliding onto middle and leg, du Preez nudges it on the leg side.
Sophie Ecclestone is brought back into the attack.
On middle and leg, flicked away straight towards mid-wicket. 67 needed now off 72 balls and this is going right down the wire.
Around off, Marizanne Kapp cannot get it away through the off side field.
Pitched up, on off. Kapp pushes it back towards the bowler who makes a good stop.
Good running! Length, around off and this is tapped towards point for a quick single.
FOUR! Muscled! Shorter in length, on off. Mignon du Preez hangs back and pulls it hard and through mid-wicket for a welcome boundary.
Fullish delivery on the pads. Kapp nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full, around off and Mignon du Preez drives it straight towards covers.
WIDE! On a length, turning well down the leg side. Good take from Amy Jones.
Around off and turning in. Du Preez pushes it towards mid off.
On middle, Kapp turns it through mid on for a single.
Flatter delivery, this is cutaway fine towards third man for a couple of runs.
Just short! Tossed up, on middle, This one holds up a bit and Kapp chips it on the bounce to mid on.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
Full, on off. Kapp plays it towards covers and wants the single. She is sent back though.
Marizanne Kapp is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Laura Wolvaardt goes for one shot too many and Kate Cross has the big fish. Back of a length, on off and it is a touch slower. Wolvaardt hangs back and takes on the pull shot. She doesn't get enough on it and ends up hitting it straight down the throat of Natalie Sciver at mid-wicket. Sciver takes a sharp catch and both set batters have now been dismissed. 78 needed now off 85 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Kate Cross

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! There's risk involved but Laura Wolvaardt is taking it on. Pitched up, in the slot and around off. Wolvaardt hits through the line of the ball and clears wide mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Du Preez taps it to deep point for a single.
A full delivery on off. Mignon du Preez drives it to covers.
A length delivery on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery, around off. This is drilled down to long on for a single.
At the stumps, Wolvaardt looks to flick it leg side but can't get it through.
Tossed up, on middle. Wolvaardt steps out and flicks it past short fine leg for a couple.
On a length, turning in. Du Preez hangs back and works it through square leg for one.
Quicker one, spinning in sharply from around off. Well watched and well kept out by Mignon du Preez.
WIDE! This is spilled way down the leg side. Wided.
Mignon du Preez is the next batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Amy Jones makes up for her previous errors and shows her class. Is it a little late though? Nicely flighted, on a driving length and outside off by Charlotte Dean. Sune Luus reaches out for it looking to push it away. Jones with a good take as the ball bounced a bit extra as well and she whips off the bails in a flash. The third umpire is called in. No spike on UktraEdge but the replay shows that Luus had her feet in the air when the bails came off. Huge moment this in the match.
Commentary.Howout: st Amy Jones b Charlotte Dean

Commentary.Commentary: Is this stumped? The third umpire first checks whether there is bat involved or not and UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat. They now check for the stumping and it shows that Luus is out of her crease. So she has to walk back and a big wicket for England.
Flatter ball, around off. Sune Luus hangs back and steers it past point for a single. 89 needed now off 96 balls.
Slowed up, on off. This is knocked down the ground for a run.
Excellent work in the deep by Katherine Brunt. Short and wide, cut away behind point by Laura Wolvaardt. Brunt gives chase and slides in to pull the ball back in. Two taken.
Quicker one, on middle. This is paddled away to short fine leg.

Dropped and four! Tossed up, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt uses her feet and goes inside out over extra cover. She doesn't quite get the elevation and Kate Cross back tracks. She stretches out to catch it only gets a fingertip on it. The ball runs away to the fence as well.
On a length, on off. This is pushed towards mid on.
This is angled into middle and leg, Wolvaardt presses forward and works it to deep square leg for one more.
Flatter and on off. Sune Luus eases it down the ground to long on for one more.
Sliding onto the pads, this is flicked away through square leg for one.
On middle, turned through mid-wicket by Luus for one more.
This time Dean sees Wolvaardt advancing and bowls it full and wide. Wolvaardt squeezes it out to deep point for a single.
On off, Laura Wolvaardt steps out again and just about manages to clear the fielder at mid off. Two taken.

Drinks! This has been a steady run-chase so far by South Africa Women. They have build partnerships and this one between the skipper, Sune Luus and Laura Wolvaardt is threatening to take the game away from England. England need wickets here and need them quickly to put the pressure back on South Africa. They were banking on their spinners on this pitch but South African batters have played them quite well so far. This is getting tight and it might come down to which team handles the pressure better in the next passage of play.
Just a tad bit short and quick, on off. Wolvaardt hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Laura Wolvaardt is able to do what she couldn't on the first delivery of this over. Tossed up, on off. Wolvaardt dances down the track and lifts it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary. South Africa Women cruising along nicely at the moment.
Slower in the air, on off. Luus pushes it to long on for a single.
Quicker and flatter delivery on middle. Luus works it towards mid-wicket.
A flatter delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to long on for a single.

Oh, no! Amy Jones has missed a straightforward stumping opportunity. This is flighted outside off, Laura Wolvaardt steps out of her crease and gets completely beaten in flight. Amy Jones is just a bit too eager and ends up spilling the ball. Wolvaardt is a relieved woman.
On off, this is lifted over covers for a couple of runs. The 50 partnership is up between these two.

Is that a missed stumping? Yes, indeed it is but a difficult chance this. Quicker one, sliding down the leg side. Sune Luus looks to step out but gets beaten in flight and gets it off the pads but Amy Jones fails to collect the ball.

NOT OUT! It was a review taken out of desperation by Heather Knight. This is floated up, fuller and around leg stump. It's almost a yorker length delivery and turning in slightly. Laura Wolvaardt looks to work it leg side but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is a huge appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. The review is taken and UltraEdge confirms that there is a slight inside edge on it. NOT OUT! It was a review taken out of desperation by Heather Knight. Laura Wolvaardt survives and gets a single as well.

Review! England Women have taken a review for LBW against Laura Wolvaardt! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows there is bat involved. So the original decision stays and Laura Wolvaardt will continue.
Flighted, on off. Wolvaardt steps out and hits it on the bounce to mid off.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt skips down the track and strokes it through extra cover for a couple of runs. Yet another fifty for her and it's been an innings of pure class so far.
Floated up, on leg stump. Luus works it through square leg for a single.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to flick it but gets a leading edge towards covers.
This is getting way too easy for South Africa! Tossed up delivery on off. Luus gets a good stride forward and pushes it to long on for a single.
Another single. This is fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt knocks ot down to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Luus works it towards mid-wicket for an easy single.
On off and turning into the batter. Laura Wolvaardt makes a little room and pushes it to covers for a single.
Slower and slightly shorter outside off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to cut but misses.
The skipper, Heather Knight brings herself into the attack now.
Goes short this time on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to the cover fielder in the ring.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Luus eases it down to long on for a single.
Another full delivery on middle. Luus hits this one again towards the bowler.
Quicker this time on middle. Luus plays it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Top-shot from the skipper! A fuller delivery on off. Luus gets under it and lifts this over mid off for a boundary.
A friendly full toss on middle this time. Laura Wolvaardt only manages to hit it towards mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter again, around off. Luus cuts it to point for a single.
Shorter length delivery around off. Luus skips down the track and works it towards short third man.
Another one that is pushed quicker on off. Luus looks to defend but gets the inside edge of her blade onto the pads.
An arm ball this time on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards the leg side and takes a quick single.
Shorter length around off. Luus cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Luus pushes it to long on for a single.
The South African skipper Sune Luus seems to have hurt her hand and the physio is out to have a look. The magic spray is applied and Luus is good to continue.
Darted on middle and leg. Luus works it towards short fine leg. 131 more needed from 139 balls.
Fuller and quicker this time on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards square leg for a single.
This is slower in the air again, on off. Luus drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Luus drives it to mid on.
Charlotte Dean is now introduced into the attack. She is making her World Cup debut today.
Loopy delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
Goes shorter this time and flatter again. Luus rocks back and cuts it to covers. Dot ball. Two runs from the over.
Quicker on middle. Luus pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up nicely and almost a yorker-length this. Luus digs it out.
A flatter delivery on middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards square leg for a single.
This time tossed up on middle. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to covers.
Flatter and shorter on off. Luus pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
On off, this is blocked out by Laura Wolvaardt.
Back of a length, tapped through covers for a single. The 100 is now up for South Africa Women.

FOUR! Every now and then Sciver keeps straying down the leg side. A length ball, around the hips. Sune Luus gets a slight tickle on it and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence. Nothing Amy Jones could do about that one.
This is pitched up, on off. Sune Luus defends it back to the bowler.
Around leg stump, Wolvaardt with a pull down to fine leg for a run.
A length ball, around off. Wolvaardt taps it towards the point region.
On off again and this is pushed towards mid off by Luus.
On off, stroked away to point.
Quicker delivery, darted into middle. Well kept out by Sune Luus.
On middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

Huge appeal from England but the umpire remains unmoved. This one slides on with the arm and Wolvaardt gets pinged on the pads around leg stump. Heather Knight doesn't review as Sophie Ecclestone knows its not turning away. The replay shows that there was an inside edge as well.
Flatter delivery, sliding into leg stump. Luus makes room and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drop and run! A length ball, on off. Luus plays it with soft hands towards cover and sneaks in a run.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Through the gap again and Sune Luus with another good cover drive. Pitched up, on off and driven past a couple of fielders through covers for a boundary. That should have been stopped though.
This is banged in short, over off stump. Wolvaardt pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, a slight shuffle from Wolvaardt but she can't get it past mid-wicket.
Around the top of off. Wolvaardt stands tall and keeps it out on the off side.
Flatter this time, angling into middle. Luus stays solid in defense.
FOUR! This is floated up, full and around off. Sune Luus stays in her crease and strokes it along the ground, through covers for a glorious boundary.
This is shorter and Luus slaps it towards cover-point.
Flighted, on a nagging length and around off. Sune Luus defends it out watchfully.
Excellent running! Flatter, on off and this is pushed out towards covers for a quick single.
Nicely floated into middle and leg. Wolvaardt is pushed onto the back foot as the ball turns away. She does well to keep it out.
Three dots in a row to end the over. Pitched up, on off and Luus eases it towards extra cover.
A tad bit short and wide. Sune Luus rocks back and cuts it straight to point.
Fuller this time, on leg and this is flicked away straight towards mid-wicket.
Ths skipper is off the mark. On middle, Sune Luus hangs back and just nudges it into the gap around square leg. She then races back for the second, good running.
Pitched up, around off. Luus pushes it nicely towards short cover.
TWO WIDES! A bit wayward this from Natalie Sciver. Length ball, down the leg side. Wolvaardt misses the flick and Amy Jones fails to colllects. The batters do cross over.
WIDE! Around middle and leg, skidding down the leg side. Wided.
Fullish delivery, on off. Wolvaardt just presents a dead bat at it.
Another lovely delivery! Tossed up around off. Luus defends this towards the off side off the front foot. Just a single from the over!
Tossed up nicely again, on off. Luus blocks this off the front foot again.
Loopy delivery on off. Luus defends this off the front foot.
This time fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
This time turn! A tossed up delivery around off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to short third man.
An arm ball on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards the leg side.
A length delivery on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards fine leg for a single.
The skipper, Sune Luus walks in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Natalie Sciver strikes and this is an important breakthrough for England. Brits would be mighty disappointed here, she did all the hard work but has thrown it away. A length delivery on middle and leg.  Brits looks to paddle-sweep it but gets a top edge towards fine leg and Kate Cross there takes a fine catch. Two down now South Africa.
Commentary.Howout: c Kate Cross b Natalie Sciver

Commentary.Commentary: Another length delivery on middle. Brits works it towards mid-wicket this time.
A length delivery on middle. Brits works it towards the leg side.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor delivery by Natalie Sciver! A length delivery around leg. Brits looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes the thigh pads and goes towards the long leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards square leg for a single.
Natalie Sciver has been handed the ball now.
Fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to push it away but gets a thick outside edge behind square on the off side.
Fifty partnership comes up! A flatter delivery on middle. Brits works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A slightly shorter delivery around off. Brits punches it to covers.
Ohh..lovely delivery! A fullish delivery, around off. Brits looks to drive but it pitches and turns away to beat the outside edge of the blade.
Sophie Ecclestone starts with  a slower delivery and shorter in length, around off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Time for some spin now as Sophie Ecclestone is brought into the attack.
Good comeback after that boundary. On a good length, on off. Brits defends this off the front foot.
On a length and around off. Brits punches it to covers.
A length delivery, on middle. Brits defends this back to the bowler now.
FOUR! This is predictable stuff from Brunt! A shorter delivery on off. Brits stays back as she expects this length and pulls it firmly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length again, this time it is around off. Brits only manages to play it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, on off. Brits pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.

Drinks! South Africa Women got off to a pretty decent start before the dangerous Lizelle Lee was dismissed by Anya Shrubsole who bowled really well and used the breeze to her advantage. Since then, Laura Wolvaardt has continued on her merry way but has found it difficult to find the gaps. Her partner Tazmin Brits has looked a bit jaded and has looked to get the boundaries rather than knocking it around. South Africa Women still need 176 runs off 204 deliveries and England Women need wickets here to put the pressure on their opponents.
A length delivery and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to point this time. She finds the fielder and a dot to end the over.
A full delivery on middle tailing back into the batter. Brits lifts this over the bowler's head for a single as the mid on fielder cuts it off.
A fullish delivery, around off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt plays it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A good shot this and it will ease the pressure! A slightly shorter length around off. Laura Wolvaardt picks the length quickly and pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to mid on.
On middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for another single by Wolvaardt.

Leg bye! A stifled appeal from Katherine Brunt but definitely sliding down leg. This is angled down the leg side, Brits with a slight shuffle looks to flick it away. She misses and the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg. They get a leg bye.
On middle this time and worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Around the top of off, Brits goes deep in her crease to keep it out.
Good-length, on off. Brits hops back to ease it on the off side.
Good running! Pitched up, on off. Wolvaardt punches it firmly off the back foot to the left of mid off and picks up a quick single.
Katherine Brunt (4-0-22-0) is back on.
A touch fuller, on the fifth stump line. Brits leaves it alone.
Length, around off and this is tapped towards covers.
FOUR! Tazmin Brits getting a move on now. Pitched up, around leg stump and this is clubbed away through wide mid on for a boundary. The 50 comes up for South Africa Women as well.
A bit of width on offer, Wolvaardt slashes it to deep point for a single.
Full again, attacking the pads. This is flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, angling into middle and leg. Wolvaardt pushes it towards wide mid on.
Fuller and on off, pushed towards extra cover. Anya Shrubsole has now bowled 6 overs upfront and maybe she needs a break now.
Nicely bowled. This is cutting back in a long way from around off. Brits does well to keep it out.
Good take from Amy Jones behind the stumps. Touch fuller, outside off. Brits misses the cover drive.
A length ball, on middle. Brits tucks it away to square leg.
FOUR! Finally, Tazmin Brits gets one away and it is a top shot! Pitched up on middle, drilled right back past nthe bowler for a boundary.
Good-length, over middle. This is jabbed through mid-wicket for a single.
Anya Shrubsole will continue. Probably the last over of her spell.

Maiden over from Kate Cross! Fullish ball, outside off and shaping away. Tazmin Brits takes a couple of steps forward and hammers it straight towards extra cover. Brits needs to knock it around a bit more rather than looking for the boundaries.
Around off, this is eased towards covers.
Around the top of off and nipping back in just a fraction. Brits hangs back and looks to push it out on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A length ball, angled into middle. Brits looks to be a bit on the edge here as she pushes it awkwardly towards mid on.
Lovely delivery! On a nagging length, around off and shaping away nicely. Almost no feet movement from Tazmin Brits as she looks to push it out. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Back of a length, around off. This is tapped back to the bowler.
On a length and hint of inswing there. It is on middle and Brits clips it to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! This is sliding down the leg side. Brits misses the flick and a wide is called.
This is banged in a bit slower and Brits dabs it down towards mid-wicket.
This is slanting in from outside off. Brits pushes it towards mid on.
A length ball, on off. Brits blocks it out.
FOUR! Short and dispatched! Tazmin Brits hangs back and rolls her wrists over the ball to find the mid-wicket fence.
Around the top of off, blocked out.
Powerplay 2! As many as 4 fielders can now be stationed outside the inner ring.

Ohh...dropped this time! A length delivery, on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives this on up again and it goes right of Cross. She takes her right hand out to catch this off her own bowling but the ball doesn't stick. This is a big miss but was a tough chance for the bowler on her followthrough.

Just short! This is just short of full-length and around off. It is not that full and Laura Wolvaardt still goes for the drive. It goes in the air towards cover-point and Sophia Dunkley moves forward to catch it but it falls short.
This time a bit of away swing. A length delivery, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt throws her bat at it and gets this over point for a couple.
A length delivery, on off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to cover-point.
Back of a length, around off. Brits goes back and punches this off the outside half of her blade to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Brits works it towards the leg side.
This time an inside edge! Back of a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to pull it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
On a length around off and this one nips back in slightly. Laura Wolvaardt goes leg side of the ball and punches it towards the off side.
Goes shorter on middle this time. Brits pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, on off. Brits drives it to covers this time.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Brits leaves it alone.
A length delivery, on off. Brits walks down the track and pushes this one back to the bowler.
Anya Shrubsole (3-0-5-1) changes ends now.

FOUR! Finally she finds the gap! A fullish delivery outside off. It is not that full but Laura Wolvaardt goes for the drive yet again. The ball goes off the outside half of his blade past point for a boundary. There is a big diving effort in the deep but it races away towards the fence.
Another drive but another dot ball! This is fuller around off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to the fielder at cover-point this time.
This time on a length and close to off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to extra-cover now.
Play and a miss! This is on a good length and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt goes for a big booming cover-drive but gets beaten.
This time on a length and outside off again. Laura Wolvaardt looks to drive it away from her body and gets the inside edge. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to cover-point.
Kate Cross is now introduced into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt steers it towards third man for a single.

FOUR! Another superb shot by Laura Wolvaardt! She is the player in form! This is fuller and slower on off. Laura Wolvaardt picks this one early and drives it through covers for a lovely boundary. Wolvaardt also becomes the leading run-scorer for South Africa Women in World Cup history.
A good-length delivery, on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it on the up towards covers.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary this! Brunt goes short on off and at a friendly height for Laura Wolvaardt. She pulls it firmly towards deep square leg for a boundary.
This is slightly fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to covers this time.
Back of a length and going away from the batter. Laura Wolvaardt dabs it towards point.
Again this one nips back in. A length delivery on off and coming into the batter. Brits works it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Brits punches it towards the off side off the back foot.
Tazmin Brits is in at number 3 for South Africa.

OUT! BOWLED! A big wicket for England Women and the dangerous Lizelle Lee walks back. Anya Shrubsole was getting that ball to nip back in regularly and that has finally brought the downfall of Lee. A length delivery, around off. Lee goes for a big swing across the line but the ball comes back in a long way and shatters the stumps. Anya Shrubsole is pumped up and a poor shot selection by Lee.
A good-length delivery, on off. A tight line again and Lee defends this off the front foot.
A length delivery, on off. Lee blocks this one out.

Lucky there for Anya Shrubsole! A poor delivery this on the pads with fine leg inside the circle. Lee clips it fine right of Sophie Ecclestone there. She dives and half-stops it. A couple of runs taken.
And again, full and straight. Wolvaardt can only manage to defend it back to the bowler.
Full and straight, this is pushed towards mid off.

UPDATE - History has been made in game number 12 where Bangladesh Women playing their first World Cup have beaten Pakistan Women in a close encounter and have opened their account on the points table.
This is slanting into middle and leg. Wolvaardt defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length, around off. Wolvaardt hangs back and eases it towards covers.
Missed out on that one did Laura Wolvaardt. This is short and wide, Wolvaardt slaps it straight to Tammy Beaumont at point.
Nicely played! On a good length, around off. Wolvaardt gets on top of the bounce and works it off the back foot through point for a couple of runs.
Length again, on off. This is tapped towards the cover region.
Around the top of off. Lizelle Lee defends it out solidly off the front foot.
This is angled into the pads. Wolvaardt nudges it towards mid-wicket and picks up a single.
And again! Full, around off and driven straight towards extra cover.
Fullish delivery, on a driving length and around off. Wolvaardt stands tall and plays the cover drive but can't get it through.
A length ball, on off and angling in. Wolvaardt looks to tuck it away leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Around off, nicely driven towards covers.
Nicely bowled! Back of the hand slower ball, pitched up on the fifth stump line. Lee makes a watchful leave.
Top shot but for just a single. Good-length, around off and played on the up past backward point for a run.
Risky single but no harm done. On off, Lee works it towards mid-wicket and sets off for the run. Natalie Sciver is just a bit late to react and the batters make it across.
A length ball, close to the off pole and this is defended towards covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Pitched up, on off and shaping away. Lizelle Lee with a slight shuffle and she whips it against the movement and over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, around off, pushed towards covers. End of an eventful second over.
WIDE! This is spilled down the leg side. Wided.

Dropped! Tammy Beaumont puts down a sitter and she cannot believe it! A half-volley wide of the off stump. Laura Wolvaardt goes chasing after it and hits it straight to Tammy Beaumont at cover-point. The ball pops in and out of her hands and that is a big moment early in the second innings.
On a driving length, close to the off pole. Wolvaardt mistimes the drive towards mid off.
This is angled back in from outside off. Wolvaardt hangs back and gets right behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Length again, around off. Wolvaardt keeps it out on the off side.
A length ball, wide of off stump. Lee hangs back and caresses it through cover-point for a single.
Anya Shrubsole to bowl from the opposite end.
Around the top of off. Wolvaardt stays solid in defense. 5 off the first over.
Length again, around off and this is played towards point.

Edged and four! On a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt hops on the back foot but pushes at it with hard hands. Wolvaardt gets a thick outside edge which goes wide of Heather Knight at first slip and runs away into the fence.
Good-length, outside off and Lizelle Lee steers it towards third man for a single. Lee and South Africa Women are off the mark.
A length ball, around off. Lee defends it out.
Right on the money from Brunt! Full, on a driving length and on off. Lizelle Lee pushes it out on the off side.
